# Subway Seat for Chroma

Chroma styles in the XML format chroma keeps in its styles/ folder, the highlighter behind Hugo, glamour and Gitea, plus the same styles as CSS classes for Hugo sites.

[Chroma](https://github.com/alecthomas/chroma) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/chroma/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Go code using chroma (glamour and Gitea pick it up by name once it ships in chroma's styles/):

```go
f, _ := os.Open("subway-seat.xml")
style, _ := chroma.NewXMLStyle(f)
styles.Register(style)
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Go code using chroma (glamour and Gitea pick it up by name once it ships in chroma's styles/):

```go
f, _ := os.Open("subway-seat-tunnel.xml")
style, _ := chroma.NewXMLStyle(f)
styles.Register(style)
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `static/css/subway-seat.css`.
- Delete `static/css/subway-seat-tunnel.css`.
- Delete `static/css/subway-seat-enamel.css`.
- Delete `static/css/london-moquette.css`.
- Delete `static/css/london-deep-level.css`.
- Delete `static/css/london-portland.css`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
